description: Environment variables for the bounded reference tree: public-build values the browser bundle may carry, and the server-runtime settings platform capabilities read.

variables.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.blastRadius: Canonical browser Supabase publishable key provisioned by env templates and native stores. It is public, not a secret; wrong values break auth/data reads or point users at the wrong project.

variables.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.blastRadius: Compatibility fallback used only when VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is absent. When both names exist, browser clients always prefer the canonical publishable key; a stale alias therefore does not override the configured target.

variables.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
variables.blastRadius: Selects browser Supabase project; wrong values break auth/data reads or point users at the wrong project.

variables.name: VITE_COMMERCE_AUTH_PROVIDER_KIND
variables.blastRadius: Selects the shipped browser customer-auth adapter. `supabase` keeps managed behavior; `node-postgres` uses the bounded passwordless reference session API; unknown values fall back to supabase.

variables.name: VITE_COMMERCE_SOCIAL_PROVIDERS
variables.blastRadius: Parsed by the social-provider helper and tests. The current login page still renders Google directly; empty values do not disable the Google button until LoginPage is wired to the helper.

variables.name: COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY
variables.blastRadius: The ISO 4217 currency this deployment prices and settles in. Unset resolves to PLATFORM_DEFAULT_CURRENCY, which is why no live environment sets it today. A value that is not three uppercase letters is refused at read time rather than corrected to the default, so a typo fails the commerce path closed instead of quietly pricing in the wrong currency. Changing it on a deployment that already has orders would reinterpret existing minor-unit amounts as a different currency; it is a launch-time decision, not an operational toggle. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION
variables.blastRadius: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region this deployment prices for. It selects which price list the pricing resolver reads, and it is a fact separate from the settlement currency because neither determines the other: many countries share one currency. Unset resolves to PLATFORM_DEFAULT_REGION, which is why no live environment sets it today. A value that is not two uppercase letters is refused at read time rather than corrected to the default. Setting it to a region with no active price list fails every quote closed with PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED rather than pricing from another region's list. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: COMMERCE_MIN_PRODUCT_PAYABLE_MINOR
variables.blastRadius: The smallest amount a product line may be sold for, in minor units. Unset, it is derived as one major unit from the settlement currency's own exponent, so a deployment settling in a currency without hundredths gets 1 rather than the 100 the code used to hard-code. It is the ceiling on how far a promotion may discount a line, so a value read as zero would let a discount drive a price below what the business approved; anything that is not a positive integer is refused at read time rather than corrected. Read at module evaluation on the server, so a malformed value stops the process instead of the first customer. It does not read commerce_settings.min_product_payable_minor, which is the database-side mirror consulted by SQL. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: COMMERCE_FISCAL_COUNTRY
variables.blastRadius: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction whose tax law issued documents cite. It is a fact separate from COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION, which selects a price list: selling from one region's list into another jurisdiction's tax regime is an ordinary arrangement and the quote port's tests pin exactly that case, so neither value is derived from the other. Unset resolves to the reference deployment's jurisdiction, which is why no live environment sets it. A value that is not two uppercase letters is refused at read time; a document issued to a tax authority under a treatment nobody chose is not something a later correction fully undoes. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: COMMERCE_FISCAL_CATEGORY
variables.blastRadius: Which supply the configured VAT rate applies to, as a free-text category name carried onto every quote's tax breakdown and every invoice's tax snapshot. Unset resolves to the reference deployment's category. It has no malformed state: the platform is in no position to tell a valid category name from an invalid one, and an empty value is treated as unset like every other key in this group. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: COMMERCE_FISCAL_VAT_RATE_BPS
variables.blastRadius: The VAT rate applied to product lines, in basis points (800 = 8 percent). It reaches every quoted amount through the included-VAT split and every issued document through the tax snapshot, so it carries the widest blast radius in this group: a wrong value misstates the net and VAT halves of every order taken while it is set. Unset resolves to the reference deployment's rate. A value that is not a whole number from 0 to 10000 is refused at read time rather than coerced. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: COMMERCE_FISCAL_LEGAL_BASIS
variables.blastRadius: The statutory citation printed on issued documents to justify the configured rate, as free text. Unset resolves to the reference deployment's citation. Like the category it has no malformed state this code can detect; a wrong citation is refused by a tax authority, not here. Browser-exposed: it matches a PUBLIC_BUNDLE_ENV_PREFIXES entry in scripts/check-client-secret-boundary.ts, so the build inlines it into the shipped JavaScript where the presentation layer reads it from import.meta.env. Never put a credential under this prefix.

variables.name: VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.blastRadius: Exposes Stripe publishable key to browser bundles; wrong values break checkout or point UI at the wrong account.

variables.name: VITE_INPOST_GEOWIDGET_KEY
variables.blastRadius: Public InPost Geowidget v5 browsing token (JWT) baked into the browser bundle. Empty => the map picker is disabled and the list fallback is used; wrong/expired values break only the InPost map overlay.

variables.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
variables.blastRadius: Vercel Blob credential for the vercel-blob capability; the store id in it also forms public object URLs. Readiness refuses the capability without it; a wrong value writes to, or links into, another store.

variables.name: BLOB_FS_ROOT
variables.blastRadius: Directory the filesystem blob capability stores objects under. Readiness refuses the capability without it; a wrong value loses access to stored objects.

variables.name: BLOB_FS_BASE_URL
variables.blastRadius: Public base URL that serves the filesystem blob directory. Readiness refuses the capability without it; a wrong value produces broken object links.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_BUCKET
variables.blastRadius: Bucket the S3-compatible blob capability stores objects in. Readiness refuses the capability without it; a wrong value writes to another bucket.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_BASE_URL
variables.blastRadius: Public base URL that serves the S3-compatible bucket. Readiness refuses the capability without it; a wrong value produces broken object links.

variables.name: PLATFORM_BLOB
variables.blastRadius: Selects the blob capability (filesystem, s3, supabase or vercel-blob) instead of the bundle's own. Readiness refuses an unknown value; a wrong but valid value stores objects in another backend.

variables.name: BLOB_SUPABASE_BUCKET
variables.blastRadius: Supabase Storage bucket the supabase blob capability uses. Readiness refuses the capability without it; a wrong value writes to another bucket.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_REGION
variables.blastRadius: Region for the s3 blob capability's client (us-east-1 when absent). A wrong value fails signed requests.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_ENDPOINT
variables.blastRadius: Endpoint of an S3-compatible service for the s3 blob capability (the provider's default when absent). A wrong value sends objects to another service.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
variables.blastRadius: true selects path-style bucket addressing for an S3-compatible service. A wrong value fails requests to services that need one style.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.blastRadius: Access key id for the s3 blob capability; set together with BLOB_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or neither to use the SDK's default credentials. Half a pair is refused.

variables.name: BLOB_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.blastRadius: Secret access key for the s3 blob capability; set together with BLOB_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID. A leaked value grants write access to the bucket.

variables.name: IDENTITY_EMAIL_VERIFYING_PROVIDERS
variables.blastRadius: Comma-separated explicit declarations of external providers that verify email. Empty trusts no external provider; malformed declarations refuse configuration. Managed email association also requires confirmations.

variables.name: OPERATOR_INVITATION_TTL_SECONDS
variables.blastRadius: Pending operator invitations expire after an integer 60..2592000 seconds; direct hosts that call the TTL parser refuse malformed values before writes. The managed reference runner does not call that parser or enforce this TTL. Active memberships do not expire.

variables.name: OPERATOR_IDENTITY_AUDIENCE
variables.blastRadius: Direct human operator JWT audience; must be nonempty and distinct from the customer audience. Uses existing ES256 issuer and key settings with a fixed 900-second lifetime.

variables.name: VITE_OPERATOR_AUTH_PROVIDER_KIND
variables.blastRadius: An application composition root passes this value to AuthProvider as providerKind: direct selects human operator login. Absence preserves managed authentication; unknown nonempty values refuse. The disposable identity profile mounts the operator shell using its explicit selected browser provider; the default static profile does not.

variables.name: OPENLUP_IDENTITY_RUN_DIR
variables.blastRadius: Private canonical directory for the disposable identity installation marker, captured messages and isolated build output.

variables.name: OPENLUP_IDENTITY_RUN_ID
variables.blastRadius: Random run identifier bound to the private marker, owned container and live installation nonce.

variables.name: OPENLUP_IDENTITY_MAIL_ORIGIN
variables.blastRadius: Owned loopback managed mail catcher used only by identity browser acceptance.
